summary: No blocking issue in the four-file typed CSV adapter. Frozen source and the one fixed independent runtime satisfy the admitted local C1-C3 contract; lead disposition remains separate.

criteria.evidence: Inspected the actual parser, route, four exact deltas and kit example. Full-text CSV framing preserves quoted JSON content and embedded newlines; malformed quoting, normalized/aliased duplicate or prototype headings, unknown typed headings and mismatched widths refuse. Any kind/version/fields/audiences heading selects explicit profile/version-1 parsing with required object cells and the existing strict typed schema, never behavioral fallback. Legacy source-only product attributes and numeric conversion remain. Both formats share fatal UTF-8 decoding and the actual streamed 1 MiB cap; logical data rows are capped at 1000 before applyHistory. The first W14.06 group exercises mapping, malformed/refused inputs, exact byte/row boundaries and legacy import with no-write assertions. Independent 10169/2cf4e9 passed.

The adapter feeds the existing schema/applyHistory lane; it adds no consent, target, profile creation, history or consumer mutation logic. The second W14.06 group passes actual session and Durable Object hosts for meridian and kate-spade sharing identity coordinates, with distinct typed/precomputed membership, immediate segments/personalization, live preservation, JSON/CSV equal-time replay, replacement/withdrawal and profile-only no-history assertions. Selector disagreement, cold profile, refused consent and erasure cutoff cases assert zero writes. Unchanged W14.05 consumers/link/restart and explicit-consent/exact-target assurance are reused; the three selected W14.05 groups and named W37.04 case also pass on frozen bytes. No numerical scoring or cross-store atomicity claim.

Before d00417 and after 97f712 independently verify all 50 artifact pins, all 41 protected baseline pins and exactly four forward/reverse patches against decoded baseline/current source. Exactly two grouped SDK cases were added. The literal K1/K3 compound ran once independently: 41 identity cases plus six selected SDK cases passed, 38 unselected, exit 0/drained with full captures below. Full worker evidence was inspected: final runtime 87157/6117f3, compiler 71151/ddbbfc, scoped lint 13543/312697 (0 errors, 94 inherited warnings/no additions per the admitted baseline and root static inspection), whitespace 31e253 all exit 0/drained. Static checks and unchanged 11 direct cases were reused, not rerun. Prior W14.05 whole-artifact qualification and residuals remain explicit.
